headline: IDEXX Releases 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report Highlighting Innovation and Sustainability Progress
summary: IDEXX Laboratories (NASDAQ:IDXX) released its 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report, outlining progress across innovation, workforce development, and environmental initiatives that support the company’s long-term growth strategy. Key Investor TakeawaysIDEXX published its 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report, highlighting advances in innovation, employee development, and sustainability.
